question.worked_solution:
To find the root of $f(x),$  we must solve $f(x)=0:$

$$
3\sqrt[6]{3x+13}-6=0
$$

We solve this equation by making $x$ the subject, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}3\sqrt[6]{3x+13}-6 & =0 \\ 3\sqrt[6]{3x+13} & =6 \\ \sqrt[6]{3x+13} & =2 \\ (\sqrt[6]{3x+13})^{6} & ={2}^{6} \\ 3x+13 & =64 \\ 3x & =51 \\ x & =17\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we must check the answer by substituting it back into the initial equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}3\sqrt[6]{3\cdot 17+13}-6 & =0 \\ 3\sqrt[6]{64}-6 & =0 \\ 3\cdot 2-6 & =0 \\ 0 & =0\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the root of $f(x)$ is $x=17.$
